title: Universaarl Global Dimension Code 1/2 assignment
purpose: Set or verify PRODUCTLINE and COSTCENTER as Global Dimension Code 1/2 in General Ledger Setup before master data/default dimensions.
entryCriteria: PRODUCTLINE, COSTCENTER and CHANNEL values are visible enough for foundation setup.
No master data has to be created in this case.
exitCriteria: General Ledger Setup before/after/reopen evidence exists.
Global Dimension Code 1 is PRODUCTLINE or a documented blocker exists.
Global Dimension Code 2 is COSTCENTER or a documented blocker exists.
No preview, posting, document draft, master data or API shortcut executed.

lookahead.reason: PRODUCTLINE and COSTCENTER can become Global Dimension Code 1/2 only after values are complete enough.
Customer/vendor/item planning should reference finished dimensions and values.
Template defaults need posting groups, VAT and dimension/default-dimension decisions.
German VAT setup needs source-backed setup decision before documents.
First master data should wait for foundation setup and default dimensions.

nextStep: Run TARGET-024C to inspect Change Global Dimensions fields/actions before another setup write attempt.
proved: General Ledger Setup / Finanzbuchhaltung Einrichtung page 118 was opened only in playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
No master data, document draft, preview posting, posting, company switch or API shortcut was executed.
notProved: Not every Global Dimension Code field could be assigned or proven with the current UI route.
Default Dimensions on customers, vendors, items or accounts are not proven.
Dimension Set Entries, posted entries and reporting filters are not proven.
German VAT or posting-group correctness is not proven by this case.
blockedBy: Global Dimension Code 1: Global Dimension Code 1 did not show PRODUCTLINE after Change Global Dimensions sequential run and reopen.
Global Dimension Code 2: Global Dimension Code 2 did not show COSTCENTER after Change Global Dimensions sequential run and reopen.
discoveries: Page 118 General Ledger Setup opens in playthru/UNIVERSAARL-DE and shows empty Global Dimension Code 1/2 fields.
Direct card edit route did not persist PRODUCTLINE/COSTCENTER.
Change Global Dimensions action page opens and accepts PRODUCTLINE/COSTCENTER in the visible left input column.
After sequential route and reopen, Page 118 still shows empty Global Dimension Code 1/2 fields.

nextStepDecisionCard.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-023B recovered all starter Dimension Values with reopen proof. TARGET-024B then tested Global Dimension Code assignment on General Ledger Setup and Change Global Dimensions.
nextStepDecisionCard.reason: Master data should not start while PRODUCTLINE/COSTCENTER are not yet proven as Global Dimension Code 1/2 and the Change Global Dimensions page field semantics are unclear.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: The next useful step is technical/page-field discovery of the Change Global Dimensions action page, not another blind write attempt.
Master data planning can continue after global-dimension route is proven or consciously parked.
Templates need posting groups, VAT and dimension/default-dimension decisions.
German VAT setup still needs source-backed setup before any document preview.
Default Dimensions need either proven global dimensions or a documented park decision plus concrete master data.

nextStepDecisionCard.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: TARGET-024B proved the page contexts and rejected two repeated write routes; the cheapest safe progress is to inspect fields/actions/columns before the next setup attempt.
risksBeforeNextCase: Do not claim Global Dimension Code 1/2 readiness from TARGET-024B screenshots.
Do not start master data/default dimensions as if global dimensions are assigned.
Do not repeat the same left-column Change Global Dimensions route.
requiredPreparation: Use Page Inspection/technical field diagnostics, tooltip/action inventory and screenshot QA on the Change Global Dimensions page.
